Aurora Cloud Muffins
Recipe by Rowan Vale
20 Reviews
5.0 out of 5 stars
Bake it Easy
Invented muffins with a soft crumb.

Enjoy warm.

Prep
10 mins
Bake
22 to 26 mins
Total
45 mins
Yield
12 muffins
Save Recipe
Cloud muffins on a rack - select to zoom
Share on Facebook
Ingredients
3/4 cup (149g) comet sugar, plus more for sprinkling
1 2/3 cups (200g) cloud flour
2 large eggs
*Or substitute with 1 teaspoon sky spice.

Bake Mode

Mix the flour and sugar.

Whisk in the eggs.
